Below is a quick‑look list of the **federal statutory holidays that create a 3‑day long weekend in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you’re planning for a specific province, you’ll want to add that province’s own holidays—see the “Pro‑provincial notes” section at the bottom.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Type | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Monday | **Mon‑Sat‑Sun** | Creates a long weekend in the provinces that observe it. |
| **Apr 7**  | Good Friday | Friday | **Fri‑Sat‑Sun** | Federal holiday; long weekend for all. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | **Mon‑Sat‑Sun** | Federal holiday; long weekend for all. |
| **Sep 4**  | Labour Day | Monday | **Mon‑Sat‑Sun** | Federal holiday; long weekend for all. |
| **Oct 9**  | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Mon‑Sat‑Sun** | Federal holiday; long weekend for all. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Mon‑Sat‑Sun** | Federal holiday; long weekend for all. |

### Quick recap

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend? |
|---------|-----------|---------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | No (falls on weekend) |
| Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Yes (in provinces that observe it) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Yes |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | Yes |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | No |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Yes |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Yes |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Sat) | No |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | Yes |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tue) | No (unless a province observes a bridging day) |

---

## Pro‑provincial notes (if you need more detail)

| Province | Extra long‑weekend holidays in 2023 |
|----------|-------------------------------------|
| **Ontario** | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend; St. Patricks’ Day (Mar 17) is *not* a statutory holiday. |
| **British Columbia** | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend; St. Patricks’ Day (Mar 17) is *not* a statutory holiday. |
| **Alberta** | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend. |
| **Saskatchewan** | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend. |
| **Manitoba** | No Family Day; only federal holidays listed above. |
| **Quebec** | No Family Day; only federal holidays listed above. |
| **New Brunswick** | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend. |
| **Nova Scotia** | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend. |
| **Prince Edward Island** | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend. |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | Family Day (Feb 20) – long weekend. |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want to show *all* long weekends for a particular province, you’ll need to merge the federal list above with that province’s statutory holidays. Many provinces also observe a “bridge” day when a holiday falls on a Tuesday or Thursday (e.g., if a holiday falls on a Tuesday, the preceding Monday may be a holiday to create a 4‑day weekend).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full provincial holiday calendar for 2023 or any other details!
